name: toru
description: Recording infrastructure for your agent: record polished product demos yourself, signed in as the user.

interface.longDescription: Your agent writes a step-by-step plan from your product's code and Toru records it in your own Chrome or an app on your Mac, then renders a polished MP4 with cursor motion, zooms and your brand. The plugin bundles the Toru skill and the hosted MCP server configuration.
defaultPrompt: Record a demo video of my web app.
Check a Toru recording and get the MP4.
Record a demo of my Mac app.
